LEFT JOIN Enrollments ON Enrollments.NetId = Students.NetId
right JOIN
(
    SELECT Courses.CRN AS CRN, (sum(Score * Credits) / sum(Credits)) as CourseAvgScore
    FROM Courses
    LEFT JOIN Enrollments ON Courses.CRN = Enrollments.CRN
    GROUP BY CRN
    HAVING CourseAvgScore >= 80.0
) C ON C.CRN = Enrollments.CRN
WHERE Score > 85.0
ORDER BY C.CRN desc, Score DESC;
